description: This file defines the Dependent class in the OrangeHRM system, representing dependents related to an employee within the reporting framework. It includes methods for converting dependents to an array and mapping fields for normalization, and interacts with Employee entities.

classes.name: Dependent
classes.description: Represents an employee's dependent within the reporting system, providing methods to serialize dependence data and map fields for reporting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Dependent object with the employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the dependents of the employee to an array, filtered by specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping from field names to getter methods for normalization.
